  html:

    self-contained: true

```{r setup, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

## Load raw data {.hidden .unnumbered .unlisted}
```{r load_raw_data, message = FALSE}
# Launches: soft-launches 1+2 (sl12) and full launch (fl) by Bilendi, full launch by Dynata (fl2)
launches <- c("sl12", "fl", "fl2")
raw_folders <- here("1_Data", "1_raw", c("2023_11_Bilendi", "2023_11_Bilendi", "2024_12_Dynata"))

# Read and stack the files of all launches
page_times <- read_csv(file.path(raw_folders, paste0("PageTimes_", launches, ".csv")))
intro <- read_csv(file.path(raw_folders, paste0("Data_intro_", launches, ".csv")),
                  col_select = c(participant_code, `_current_page_name`))
training <- read_csv(file.path(raw_folders, paste0("Data_training_", launches, ".csv")),
                     col_select = c(participant_code, total_number_errors_hidden, comprehension_errors_hidden))
```

## Keep participants who reached the final page {.hidden .unnumbered .unlisted}
```{r keep_complete_participants}
complete_codes <- intro %>%
  filter(`_current_page_name` == "P03_Thank_You") %>%
  pull(participant_code)

page_times <- page_times %>% filter(participant_code %in% complete_codes)
training <- training %>% filter(participant_code %in% complete_codes)
```

## Time spent on each page {.hidden .unnumbered .unlisted}
```{r time_per_page}
# epoch_time is when a page was submitted, so the gap to the next submit is the time spent on the next page
page_times <- page_times %>%
  arrange(participant_code, epoch_time) %>%
  group_by(participant_code, session_code) %>%
  mutate(time_on_page = lead(epoch_time) - epoch_time) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Time spent on the experiment {.hidden .unnumbered .unlisted}
```{r time_per_participant}
experiment_apps <- c("intro", "training_task", paste0("decision_block_", 1:5), "survey")

# Total time = last submit minus P0_Intro submit (rows without an app, e.g. Dynata's InitializeParticipant, are dropped)
time_per_participant <- page_times %>%
  filter(app_name %in% experiment_apps) %>%
  group_by(participant_code, session_code) %>%
  summarize(seconds_on_experiment = sum(time_on_page, na.rm = TRUE),
            minutes_on_experiment = seconds_on_experiment / 60,
            pages_seen = n(),
            .groups = "drop")
```

## Save quality controls {.hidden .unnumbered .unlisted}
```{r save_quality_controls}
quality_controls <- time_per_participant %>%
  inner_join(training, by = "participant_code")

write_csv(quality_controls, here("1_Data", "2_processed", "Quality_Controls.csv"))
```
